items.text: Never have I ever cancelled plans at the last minute
Never have I ever forgotten a friend's birthday
Never have I ever borrowed money from a friend and forgot to pay it back
Never have I ever cried in front of a friend
Never have I ever given a friend a haircut
Never have I ever read a friend's message by accident
Never have I ever lied to a friend to protect their feelings
Never have I ever kept a friend's secret for more than a year
Never have I ever gone on a trip with a friend and regretted it
Never have I ever ghosted a friend
Never have I ever told a friend their partner was wrong for them
Never have I ever watched a close friend move away
Never have I ever cried at a friend's wedding
Never have I ever been jealous of a friend's success
Never have I ever shared a bed with a friend after a night out
Never have I ever made a friend a playlist
Never have I ever forgiven a friend for something big
Never have I ever sent a voice note to a friend by mistake
Never have I ever apologised to a friend when I was not at fault
Never have I ever lent a friend my favourite jacket
Never have I ever waited for a friend for more than an hour
Never have I ever cooked a meal for a friend's whole family
Never have I ever told a friend a white lie about their new haircut
Never have I ever been the reason a friend got lost
Never have I ever planned a surprise party for a friend
Never have I ever been woken up at 3am by a friend in trouble
Never have I ever defended a friend who was in the wrong
Never have I ever rated a friend's cooking honestly to their face
Never have I ever made a group chat just for a few friends
Never have I ever moved in with a friend
Never have I ever covered a friend's bill and never asked for it back
Never have I ever had food on my face all night and nobody told me
Never have I ever gone on a blind date set up by a friend
Never have I ever been a bridesmaid or a best man
Never have I ever cancelled a trip with friends because of money
Never have I ever asked a friend to help me move house
Never have I ever shared a secret crush with a friend and regretted it
Never have I ever minded a friend's bag for hours at a festival
Never have I ever been the friend who always picks the restaurant
Never have I ever kept a gift from a friend and forgotten who gave it
Never have I ever cried laughing with a friend in public
Never have I ever broken a friend's favourite mug
Never have I ever been a wingman
Never have I ever had a friend become my flatmate
Never have I ever introduced two friends who ended up dating
